item.title: Midwest Crop Conference
item.description: The Midwest Crop Conference returns to St. Joseph in 2026. Agricultural professionals from across the Midwest are invited to attend the Conference, January 20th–21st. This annual event offers two full days of continuing education units (CEUs) in key areas, including crop management, pest management, nutrient management, and soil & water management. item.title: Tuesday Chillicothe Police Report
item.description: Chillicothe police officers conducted traffic stops, business checks and responded to 55 calls for service on Tuesday, December 23rd, including at 9:49 a.m., Officers were dispatched to a two vehicle non-injury traffic crash at Clay and Cherry Streets. A report was taken. At 6:00 p.m., Officers took a report of stealing. The investigation is ongoing.
